from sqlmodel import Session, create_engine, select
from app.core.config import DATABASE_URL
from app.models.photo import Photo
from app.services.photo_media import private_photo_image_path
engine=create_engine(DATABASE_URL, connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
with Session(engine) as s:
    photos=list(s.exec(select(Photo).where(Photo.status=='approved').order_by(Photo.id)).all())
normal=next(p for p in photos if not p.original_path.lower().endswith('.bin'))
bin_photo=next(p for p in photos if p.original_path.lower().endswith('.bin'))
for p in (normal, bin_photo):
    print(f'{p.id}\t{p.place_id}\t{private_photo_image_path(p)}\t{p.public_path}')
PY
while IFS=$'\t' read -r photo_id place_id original url; do
  tmp=".dev/hash-$photo_id.bin"
  hdr=".dev/hash-$photo_id.headers"
  curl -fsS --max-time 60 -D "$hdr" "http://127.0.0.1:8000$url" -o "$tmp"
  orig_sha=$(sha256sum "$original" | awk '{print $1}')
  http_sha=$(sha256sum "$tmp" | awk '{print $1}')
  ctype=$(awk 'BEGIN{IGNORECASE=1} /^content-type:/{gsub("\r",""); print $0}' "$hdr" | tail -n1)
  echo "hash_check photo=$photo_id original=$orig_sha http=$http_sha $ctype"
  test "$orig_sha" = "$http_sha"
  rm -f "$tmp" "$hdr"
done < .dev/photo-hash-samples-ca165a9.tsv
backend/.venv/bin/python scripts/diagnose_local_data.py > .dev/diagnose-after-ca165a9.txt
tail -n 40 .dev/diagnose-after-ca165a9.txt
echo '=== DISK AFTER ==='
du -sb backend/storage
df -B1 / | tail -n1
echo 'service_status='$(systemctl is-active photomap.service)
echo 'production_head='$(git rev-parse HEAD)
rm -rf .dev/frontend-dist-before-ca165a9
REMOTE
